sentences.text: Thomas Schinecker has led Roche since March 2023, having previously run its Diagnostics division.

sentences.quote: In 2025, Roche achieved sales growth of 7% (2% in CHF) to CHF 61.5 billion due to strong demand for pharmaceutical products and diagnostic solutions.
sentences.text: Under his tenure Roche reported 2025 sales growth of 7% at constant rates to CHF 61.5 billion, with core operating profit up 13% and core EPS up 11%, and sales rose a further 6% at constant rates in the first half of 2026.

Capital allocation has stayed shareholder-friendly, with a proposed 1% dividend rise to CHF 9.80, a 39th consecutive increase at a 50.4% payout ratio, alongside a planned USD 50 billion US investment over five years.

sentences.text: Roche Holding AG grew first-half 2026 sales by 6% at constant exchange rates to CHF 30,364 million, with core operating profit up 10% to CHF 11,856 million.

sentences.quote: Diagnostics Division sales were +3% at CER, -3% when reported in CHF and +6% in USD, driven by demand for immunodiagnostic and clinical chemistry products as well as pathology and molecular solutions.
sentences.text: Growth is broad-based, with pharmaceuticals up 6% at CER led by Xolair, Hemlibra, Ocrevus, Phesgo and Vabysmo, and diagnostics up 3% at CER on immunodiagnostics, clinical chemistry, pathology and molecular solutions.

In obesity, CT-388 delivered 22.5% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 48 weeks in Phase II and two Phase III trials started in the first quarter of 2026, alongside a combination study with petrelintide, partnered with Zealand Pharma.
Roche cites up to 19 new molecular entities with launch potential by 2030, including trontinemab in Alzheimer's disease.

thesis_pillars.text: Roche Holding AG grew first-half 2026 sales by 6% at constant exchange rates to CHF 30,364 million, with core operating profit up 10% to CHF 11,856 million. Growth is broad-based, with pharmaceuticals up 6% at CER led by Xolair, Hemlibra, Ocrevus, Phesgo and Vabysmo, and diagnostics up 3% at CER on immunodiagnostics, clinical chemistry, pathology and molecular solutions. Roche expects to further increase its dividend in Swiss francs.
